1.text: “Kandi uzareme ubwo buturo, ubusakaze imyenda cumi, uyiboheshe ubudodo bw'ibitare bwiza buboheranije, n'ubw'umukara wa kabayonga n'ubw'umuhengeri n'ubw'umuhemba, bayibohemo ibishushanyo by'abakerubi, abahanga b'ibyo abe ari bo babiboha.

2.text: Uburebure bw'umwenda wose bube mikono makumyabiri n'umunani, ubugari bwawo bube mikono ine, imyenda yose ibe urugero rumwe.

3.text: Imyenda itanu ikombatwe ukwayo, n'iyindi itanu ikombatwe ukwayo.

4.text: Kandi udode imikondo y'udutambaro tw'imikara ya kabayonga ku musozo w'umwenda uhera igikombate kimwe, udode yindi nka yo ku musozo w'umwenda uhera ikindi gikombate.

5.text: Udode imikondo mirongo itanu ku mwenda umwe, n'indi mirongo itanu uyidode ku musozo w'umwenda uhera ikindi gikombate, iyo mikondo yerekerane.

6.text: Ucure ibikwasi by'izahabu mirongo itanu ubifatanishe ibyo bikombate, ubwo buturo bube bumwe.

7.text: “Kandi uzabohe imyenda yo gusakara y'ubwoya bw'ihene, ibe ihema risakara ubwo buturo, ubohe imyenda cumi n'umwe.

8.text: Uburebure bw'umwenda wose bube mikono mirongo itatu, ubugari bwawo bube mikono ine, iyo myenda uko ari cumi n'umwe ibe urugero rumwe.

9.text: Ukombate imyenda itanu ukwayo, n'iyindi itandatu uyikombate ukwayo, uwa gatandatu uwubindūre imbere y'ihema.

10.text: Udode imikondo mirongo itanu ku musozo w'umwenda uhera igikombate kimwe, n'indi mirongo itanu uyidode ku musozo w'umwenda uhera ikindi gikombate.

11.text: Ucure ibikwasi by'imiringa mirongo itanu ubishyire muri iyo mikondo, ufatanye iryo hema ribe rimwe.

12.text: Igice cy'imyenda y'ihema gisagaho kikarērēta, ni cyo gice gisagaho cy'umwenda umwe kingana n'ikindi, kirērētere inyuma y'ubwo buturo.

13.text: Ubwo ibikombate by'ihema bisagaho mukono umwe mu burebure bw'uruhande rumwe, n'indi ibiri mu rundi, irērētere mu mbavu z'ubuturo zombi, iritwikīre.

14.text: “Kandi uzaciranye igisakara iryo hema mu mpu z'amasekurume y'intama zizigishijwe inzigo itukura, ukirenzeho igicirane cy'impu z'inyamaswa zitwa tahashi.

15.text: “Kandi uzabāze imbaho z'imiganda y'ubwo buturo mu mushita, uzishinge.

16.text: Uburebure bw'urubaho rwose bube mikono cumi, ubugari bwarwo bube mukono umwe n'igice.

17.text: Kandi ku rubaho rwose habe inkarwe ebyiri zifatanye, abe ari ko uzibāza ku mbaho z'ubwo buturo zose.

18.text: Ubāze imbaho z'imiganda yabwo, iz'uruhande rw'iburyo zibe makumyabiri.

19.text: Kandi uzacure imyobo mirongo ine mu ifeza, ibe hasi y'izo mbaho uko ari makumyabiri. Imyobo ibiri ibe hasi y'urubaho rumwe, ishingwemo inkarwe zarwo zombi, bityo bityo.

20.text: Kandi uzabāze imbaho makumyabiri z'urundi ruhande rw'ubwo buturo rw'ibumoso,

21.text: uzicurire imyobo mirongo ine mu ifeza, imyobo ibiri ibe hasi y'urubaho rumwe, bityo bityo.

22.text: Kandi uzabāze imbaho esheshatu zo mu mwinjiro w'ubwo buturo, iburengerazuba.

23.text: Ubāze imbaho ebyiri z'impfuruka zabwo zo mu mwinjiro.

24.text: Hasi zibe izivuyemo nk'ebyiri, kandi zibe imyishyikire zigere ku mpeta ya mbere, abe ari ko biba kuri zombi zibe izo ku mpfuruka zo mu mwinjiro.

25.text: Nuko izo mbaho zizabe umunani, imyobo y'ifeza yo kuzishingamo izabe cumi n'itandatu, imyobo ibiri ibe hasi y'urubaho rumwe, bityo bityo.

26.text: “Kandi uzabāze imbumbe mu mushita, imbumbe eshanu zo ku mbaho z'imiganda y'uruhande rumwe rw'ubwo buturo,

27.text: na zindi eshanu zo ku mbaho z'imiganda y'urundi ruhande rwabwo, n'izindi eshanu zo mu mwinjiro wabwo, iburengerazuba.

28.text: Imbumbe yo hagati y'izindi iringanije imbaho, ibe umwishyikire.

29.text: Kandi izo mbaho uzaziyagirizeho izahabu, ucure impeta mu izahabu zo kuzishyiraho, zisesekwemo izo mbumbe, imbumbe na zo uziyagirizeho izahabu.

30.text: Uzashinge ubwo buturo buhwanye n'icyitegererezo cyabwo werekewe kuri uyu musozi.

31.text: “Kandi umwenda ukingiriza uzawuboheshe ubudodo bw'umukara wa kabayonga, n'ubw'umuhengeri n'ubw'umuhemba, n'ubw'ibitare byiza buboheranije, bawubohemo ibishushanyo by'abakerubi, abahanga b'ibyo abe ari bo babiboha.

32.text: Uwumanike ku nkingi enye zibajwe mu mushita ziyagirijweho izahabu, inkonzo zo kuri zo zicurwe mu izahabu, zishingwe mu myobo ine y'ifeza.

33.text: Umanike uwo mwenda munsi ya bya bikwasi, ushyire hirya yawo ya sanduku y'Ibihamya, uwo mwenda ubabere urugabano rw'Ahera n'Ahera cyane.

34.text: Kandi uzashyire ya ntebe y'ihongerero kuri iyo sanduku y'Ibihamya, iri Ahera cyane.

35.text: Kandi ya meza uyashyire hino y'uwo mwenda, na cya gitereko cy'amatabaza ugishyire mu ruhande rw'iburyo rw'ubwo buturo, kibangikane n'ayo meza, ameza uyashyire mu ruhande rw'ibumoso.

36.text: “Kandi umwenda wo gukinga umuryango w'iryo Hema, uzawuremeshe ubudodo bw'umukara wa kabayonga, n'ubw'umuhengeri n'ubw'umuhemba, n'ubw'ibitare byiza buboheranije, abahanga b'ibyo abe ari bo bawudodaho amabara.

37.text: Kandi uzawubārize inkingi eshanu mu mushita uziyagirizeho izahabu, inkonzo zo kuri zo zicurwe mu izahabu, kandi utekere izo nkingi imiringa, ivemo imyobo itanu yo kuzishingamo.
